actions.name: AddTagsToResource
actions.description: Grants permission to add tags to an ElastiCache resource

actions.name: AuthorizeCacheSecurityGroupIngress
actions.description: Grants permission to authorize an EC2 security group on a ElastiCache security group

actions.name: BatchApplyUpdateAction
actions.description: Grants permission to apply ElastiCache service updates to sets of clusters and replication groups

actions.name: BatchStopUpdateAction
actions.description: Grants permission to stop ElastiCache service updates from being executed on a set of clusters

actions.name: CompleteMigration
actions.description: Grants permission to complete an online migration of data from hosted Redis on Amazon EC2 to ElastiCache

actions.name: Connect
actions.description: Grants permission to connect as a specified ElastiCache user to an ElastiCache Replication Group or ElastiCache serverless cache

actions.name: CopyServerlessCacheSnapshot
actions.description: Grants permission to make a copy of an existing serverless cache snapshot

actions.name: CopySnapshot
actions.description: Grants permission to make a copy of an existing snapshot

actions.name: CreateCacheCluster
actions.description: Grants permission to create a cache cluster

actions.name: CreateCacheParameterGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to create a parameter group

actions.name: CreateCacheSecurityGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to create a cache security group

actions.name: CreateCacheSubnetGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to create a cache subnet group

actions.name: CreateGlobalReplicationGroup

actions.name: CreateServerlessCache
actions.description: Grants permission to create a serverless cache

actions.name: CreateServerlessCacheSnapshot
actions.description: Grants permission to create a copy of a serverless cache at a specific moment in time

actions.name: CreateSnapshot
actions.description: Grants permission to create a copy of an entire Redis cluster at a specific moment in time

actions.description: Grants permission to create a user for Redis. Users are supported from Redis 6.0 onwards

actions.name: CreateUserGroup

actions.name: DecreaseNodeGroupsInGlobalReplicationGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to decrease the number of node groups in global replication groups

actions.name: DecreaseReplicaCount
actions.description: Grants permission to decrease the number of replicas in a Redis (cluster mode disabled) replication group or the number of replica nodes in one or more node groups (shards) of a Redis (cluster mode enabled) replication group

actions.name: DeleteCacheCluster
actions.description: Grants permission to delete a previously provisioned cluster

actions.name: DeleteCacheParameterGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to delete the specified cache parameter group

actions.name: DeleteCacheSecurityGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to delete a cache security group

actions.name: DeleteCacheSubnetGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to delete a cache subnet group

actions.name: DeleteGlobalReplicationGroup

actions.name: DeleteReplicationGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to delete an existing replication group

actions.name: DeleteServerlessCache
actions.description: Grants permission to delete a serverless cache

actions.name: DeleteServerlessCacheSnapshot
actions.description: Grants permission to delete a serverless cache snapshot

actions.name: DeleteSnapshot
actions.description: Grants permission to delete an existing snapshot

actions.description: Grants permission to delete an existing user and thus remove it from all user groups and replication groups where it was assigned

actions.name: DeleteUserGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to delete an existing user group

actions.name: DescribeCacheClusters

actions.name: DescribeCacheEngineVersions
actions.description: Grants permission to list available cache engines and their versions

actions.description: Grants permission to list cache parameter group descriptions

actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve the detailed parameter list for a particular cache parameter group

actions.name: DescribeCacheSecurityGroups
actions.description: Grants permission to list cache security group descriptions

actions.name: DescribeCacheSubnetGroups
actions.description: Grants permission to list cache subnet group descriptions

actions.name: DescribeEngineDefaultParameters
actions.description: Grants permission to retrieve the default engine and system parameter information for the specified cache engine

actions.name: DescribeEvents
actions.description: Grants permission to list events related to clusters, cache security groups, and cache parameter groups

actions.name: DescribeGlobalReplicationGroups
actions.description: Grants permission to list information about global replication groups

actions.name: DescribeReplicationGroups
actions.description: Grants permission to list information about provisioned replication groups

actions.name: DescribeReservedCacheNodes
actions.description: Grants permission to list information about purchased reserved cache nodes

actions.name: DescribeReservedCacheNodesOfferings
actions.description: Grants permission to list available reserved cache node offerings

actions.name: DescribeServerlessCacheSnapshots
actions.description: Grants permission to list information about serverless cache snapshots

actions.name: DescribeServerlessCaches
actions.description: Grants permission to list serverless caches

actions.name: DescribeServiceUpdates
actions.description: Grants permission to list details of the service updates

actions.name: DescribeSnapshots
actions.description: Grants permission to list information about cluster or replication group snapshots

actions.name: DescribeUpdateActions
actions.description: Grants permission to list details of the update actions for a set of clusters or replication groups

actions.name: DescribeUserGroups
actions.description: Grants permission to list information about Redis user groups

actions.name: DescribeUsers
actions.description: Grants permission to list information about Redis users

actions.name: DisassociateGlobalReplicationGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to remove a secondary replication group from the global replication group

actions.name: ExportServerlessCacheSnapshot
actions.description: Grants permission to export a copy of a serverless cache at a specific moment in time to s3 bucket

actions.name: FailoverGlobalReplicationGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to failover the primary region to a selected secondary region of a global replication group

actions.name: IncreaseNodeGroupsInGlobalReplicationGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to increase the number of node groups in a global replication group

actions.name: IncreaseReplicaCount
actions.description: Grants permission to increase the number of replicas in a Redis (cluster mode disabled) replication group or the number of replica nodes in one or more node groups (shards) of a Redis (cluster mode enabled) replication group

actions.name: ListAllowedNodeTypeModifications
actions.description: Grants permission to list available node type that can be used to scale a particular Redis cluster or replication group

actions.name: ListTagsForResource
actions.description: Grants permission to list tags for an ElastiCache resource

actions.name: ModifyCacheCluster
actions.description: Grants permission to modify settings for a cluster

actions.name: ModifyCacheParameterGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to modify parameters of a cache parameter group

actions.name: ModifyCacheSubnetGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to modify an existing cache subnet group

actions.name: ModifyGlobalReplicationGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to modify settings for a global replication group

actions.name: ModifyReplicationGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to modify the settings for a replication group

actions.name: ModifyReplicationGroupShardConfiguration
actions.description: Grants permission to add shards, remove shards, or rebalance the keyspaces among existing shards of a replication group

actions.name: ModifyServerlessCache
actions.description: Grants permission to modify parameters for a serverless cache

actions.name: ModifyUser
actions.description: Grants permission to change Redis user password(s) and/or access string

actions.name: ModifyUserGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to change list of users that belong to the user group

actions.name: PurchaseReservedCacheNodesOffering
actions.description: Grants permission to purchase a reserved cache node offering

actions.name: RebalanceSlotsInGlobalReplicationGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to perform a key space rebalance operation to redistribute slots and ensure uniform key distribution across existing shards in a global replication group

actions.name: RebootCacheCluster
actions.description: Grants permission to reboot some, or all, of the cache nodes within a provisioned cache cluster or replication group (cluster mode disabled)

actions.name: RemoveTagsFromResource
actions.description: Grants permission to remove tags from a ElastiCache resource

actions.name: ResetCacheParameterGroup
actions.description: Grants permission to modify parameters of a cache parameter group back to their default values

actions.name: RevokeCacheSecurityGroupIngress
actions.description: Grants permission to remove an EC2 security group ingress from a ElastiCache security group

actions.name: StartMigration
actions.description: Grants permission to start a migration of data from hosted Redis on Amazon EC2 to ElastiCache for Redis

actions.name: TestFailover
actions.description: Grants permission to test automatic failover on a specified node group in a replication group

actions.name: TestMigration
actions.description: Grants permission to test a migration of data from hosted Redis on Amazon EC2 to ElastiCache for Redis

actions.name: InterruptClusterAzPower
actions.description: Grants permission to test an AZ power interruption for an ElastiCache resource
